versions.changelog:
- Initial release of AI Content Humanizer skill.
- Systematically rewrites AI-generated text to sound natural and undetectable.
- Removes common AI patterns: filler phrases, clichés, jargon, hedging, symmetry.
- Adds human writing traits: varied sentence lengths, contractions, natural transitions, specific examples, and more.
- Includes voice calibration guides for blogs, emails, sales, technical docs, and social media.
- Features an "acid test" checklist to ensure authentic, human-like tone.
- Supports context-based voice adjustments and references industry-specific context packs.
